textRuns.value: Both charts use the same data and the same division, bounded to the week of 26 August 2024. The left one returns BLANK where there are no sales and the right one returns zero: fourteen of the 58 brands disappear from the first and are drawn flat on the floor in the second. In a table both take up one cell and read the same. Neither is wrong: blank says "I did not measure it" and zero says "I measured it and it came out zero". What is wrong is not knowing which one you are publishing.
